meta.title: dsh-web-search-anysearch
meta.description: AnySearch web search provider: serves the harness /web tool through your AnySearch credentials.

en.apiKeyHint: Stores the ANYSEARCH_API_KEY credential; leave blank to keep the current key.
en.cleared: Key cleared; searches are back to the anonymous limits.
en.loadFailed: Could not read the credential state.
en.readOnly: The credential source is read-only, so a key cannot be written here.
en.saved: Saved; it applies to the next search.
en.saveFailed: The deployment refused it; nothing was written.
en.summary: Drives web_search with your own AnySearch credential (anonymous works too, at lower limits).
en.uiUnavailable: This dsh web frontend does not serve the UI components (client-ui-primitives) this page renders with; upgrade dsh and retry.
en.unavailable: This deployment serves no credential service, so a key cannot be written here.
